name: Auslink Communications
summary: Sydney retail ISP arm of OurWorld Global Network; launched a national flat-rate Internet access service (May 1998) on OGN's satellite backbone; folded when OGN failed in 1998.

events.details: Auslink Communications Pty Ltd (ACN 077 048 938, registered c. 1996; GPO Box 4773 Sydney — the same box as OurWorld Global Network); operating by Dec 1997 (earliest Wayback capture).

Launched an Australia-wide flat-rate Internet access service ($350/yr or $120/quarter) with POPs in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Perth, using the internet backbone supplied by OurWorld Global Network; GM Samantha Teh at OGN's phone 02-9223-2777. This was OGN's retail arm, built on the iiNet SA base OGN bought in Apr 1997 as the foundation for its national service.

events.details: Folded when OurWorld Global Network failed quietly in 1998 and was liquidated; customers were part of the base bought from the liquidator by Chariot. auslink.net pivoted to SmartServers (virtual/dedicated server hosting) by 1999.
